in_sanskrit.name: धर्मदास
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who serves Dharma, or the moral law and duty

in_hindi.name: धर्मदास
in_hindi.meaning: धर्म (Dharma) + दास (daas) = धर्म (Dharma) + दवीदा (daas) = धर्मी दवीदा (dharmi davida)

in_tamil.name: தர்மதாஸ்
in_tamil.meaning: தர்மம் (Dharma) + தாஸ் (daas) = தர்மம் வாசி (dharma vasai) = One who serves Dharma
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who serves Dharma, or the moral law and duty

in_telugu.name: ధర్మదాశ్
in_telugu.meaning: ధర్మ (Dharma) + దాశ్ (daas) = ధర్మయోజియేదోభో (dharma yojavedu) = One who serves Dharma
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who serves Dharma, or the moral law and duty

in_marathi.name: Dharmadaas
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dharma (duty, righteousness) + daas (servant)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharmadaas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who serves dharma, the natural order of the universe. Dharmadaas embodies righteousness, duty, and selflessness.
